tvShow.name: Pubertat
tvShow.overview: The harmony of a community is shattered by an allegation of sexual assault on social media that points to three teenagers as the main suspects.

episodes.name: The demons
episodes.overview: On the night of Saint John’s Eve, an incident among teenagers shatters the harmony of a community.

episodes.name: The doubt
episodes.overview: The adults realize they don’t know their children as well as they thought.

episodes.name: The family
episodes.overview: After Lucía’s post on social media, accusing three teenagers of being responsible for a sexual assault, all the families are forced to take a stand.

episodes.name: The friendship
episodes.overview: Manuela, Pol, and Steven are best friends. But something will change their relationship forever.

episodes.name: The wound
episodes.overview: Manuela is deeply affected by everything that has happened, and her father doesn’t know how to help her.

episodes.name: The collective action
episodes.overview: After what happened that summer, the big question remains: which path will the community choose?
